plain: An American inventor named Thomas Townsend Brown is said to have had a UFO encounter at about age 17, around 1922, that shaped all his later work. Michels tells it several times, placing it on Catalina Island off California and describing a small orb of light that came right up to the young Brown, though once he hedges with "I think" on the age and place. Citing Brown's daughter, Michels says this was when Brown "downloaded his life's work," while he had a lab in Pasadena. The daughter, Linda Brown, tells it herself on the show, saying her father "learned so much standing there with that ball of light." If true, it would mean Brown's research had its start in a contact with something unknown.
